# Encounters in Joy

> Encounters in Joy, Inc. is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit Christian counseling ministry in Statham, Georgia (Barrow County). It offers faith-grounded pastoral counseling for individuals, couples, families, and youth, in person or by Zoom, plus a free monthly grief support group. People of any faith or none are welcome.

Key facts:

- Office: 2064 Highway 82, Statham, GA 30666. Sessions by appointment, in person or by Zoom.
- Phone: 770-807-1227 (call and leave a voicemail, or text). Email: brojefflangley@encountersinjoy.org. A real person responds within 24 hours.
- Serves Barrow, Jackson, Gwinnett, Oconee, Walton, and Clarke counties, including Statham, Winder, Bethlehem, Bogart, Athens, Watkinsville, Monroe, Jefferson, Auburn, and Loganville.
- Cost: a set fee per session, due at the time of service. Insurance is not accepted. A sliding scale (based on family size and income) and a donor-supported Counseling Scholarship Fund are available, so cost is never the reason someone goes without help.
- Counselors: Reverend Jeff Langley (founder; 35 years in ministry; board certified with the International Board of Christian Care; Certified Trauma Informed Coach; trauma and grief coaching certification through Light University; Master's in Human Services, Liberty University) and Stephanie Langley (Certified Christian Counselor; Master's in Clinical Counseling, Brenau University).
- Licensing: the counselors provide pastoral counseling and are not licensed by the State of Georgia as LPC, LMFT, or LCSW. For severe psychiatric conditions or court-ordered care, a licensed clinician is the right fit.
- Encounters in Grief: a free support group for anyone carrying any kind of loss. Meets the second Sunday of every month at 3:30 PM at the Statham office. No need to speak. Upcoming dates are listed at https://encountersinjoy.org/grief.html#group
- Encounters in Families: a family support group, forming now.
- Not a crisis service. In a crisis, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) or call 911.
- To get started: send a message through the form on any page, or call 770-807-1227. The longer intake paperwork comes after a first conversation.

## Pages

- [Home](https://encountersinjoy.org/): overview, FAQ, and contact form
- [Services](https://encountersinjoy.org/services.html): individual, couples, family, youth, and trauma and grief counseling, and the support groups
- [Grief counseling and support group](https://encountersinjoy.org/grief.html): one-on-one grief counseling and the free monthly Encounters in Grief group, with upcoming dates
- [Getting through the holidays after a loss](https://encountersinjoy.org/holiday-grief.html): a practical guide for grieving people during Thanksgiving and Christmas
- [Why we don't take insurance](https://encountersinjoy.org/why-no-insurance.html): fees, sliding scale, scholarship fund, and when a licensed clinician is the better choice
- [About](https://encountersinjoy.org/about.html): mission, programs, counselors, and nonprofit details (EIN 83-4371871)
- [Contact](https://encountersinjoy.org/contact.html): phone, email, address, and the contact form
- [Intake forms](https://encountersinjoy.org/intake.html): the counseling intake packet to print or download
- [Blog](https://encountersinjoy.org/blog/): reflections on grief, anxiety, marriage, and hard seasons from the counselors
